1. **Root cause:** The catalog item `ans-bu-wksp-rhel-91` has **not yet been merged to the main branch** of `rhpds/agnosticv`. It exists only on an unmerged PR branch (`add-ans-bu-wksp-rhel-91`, PR #4127). The job was triggered against a catalog definition that is incomplete or mid-review — specifically missing the `sandbox_aws_region` variable.

2. **Fix:** Add `sandbox_aws_region` to either `common.yaml` or `prod.yaml` in [PR #4127](https://github.com/rhpds/agnosticv/pull/4127) before merging. This variable must be set to a valid AWS region (e.g. `us-east-1`).

3. **Do not re-provision** until PR #4127 is merged with the missing variable defined.
